description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). A preliminary hint by the air conditioner's brand and the error code on its display: the probable cause (a breakdown type) and the company's starting price for it. It is not a diagnosis. Before giving it, tell the client it is an automatic hint, that the technician confirms the cause and the final price on site, and get their agreement — then pass client_accepted_disclaimer: true (also to book_appointment with the diagnosis). Brands: daikin, mitsubishi_electric, lg, samsung, gree, midea, panasonic, carrier, haier, tcl, other.

client_accepted_disclaimer.description: The client agreed that this is an automatic hint, not a diagnosis.

code.description: The code on the display, e.g. U4, E1, CH05.

company.description: The company: the `company` of a find_companies result.

lang.description: Language for names and labels: ru, es, en, ar, pt, fr, de, it, tr, id, vi, th. Default en.
